verdict.rationale: Opting out of a SaaS vendor's own usage tracking is a fair privacy question for an observability service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents any opt-out of Honeycomb's product telemetry or usage analytics. Its 'telemetry' references describe customer data users deliberately send to Honeycomb, and EU/US region selection is a data-residency control, not an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
